notes.agrum: Reads the network's UAI file and its observations, the file Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers its own program: the Dice programs of its comparison in exact rationals, the population model in floating point (its masses summed over the bits of the circuit).
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the network's UAI file and its observations, the file Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the network's UAI file and its observations, the file Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: On the weather factory the model is Rubicon's PRISM model, not the program: the same Markov chain. On the other programs it is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers the Dice programs exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added. On its own linear regression it answers the posterior means of the continuous model, E(a) and E(b), which the circuit's bit queries do not have, so there is nothing to compare them with.
notes.sppl: SPPL answers the continuous model, with normal emissions as densities; the circuit rounds them to a grid, so the differences from the reference are that discretization.
notes.storm: On the weather factory the model is Rubicon's PRISM model, not the program: the same Markov chain. On the other programs it is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the network's UAI file and its observations, the file Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.prism: On the weather factory the model is Rubicon's PRISM model, not the program: the same Markov chain. On the other programs it is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers the Dice programs exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added. On its own linear regression it answers the posterior means of the continuous model, E(a) and E(b), which the circuit's bit queries do not have, so there is nothing to compare them with.
notes.sppl: SPPL answers the continuous model, with normal emissions as densities; the circuit rounds them to a grid, so the differences from the reference are that discretization.
notes.storm: On the weather factory the model is Rubicon's PRISM model, not the program: the same Markov chain. On the other programs it is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the network's UAI file and its observations, the file Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

;; survey.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(define complement?
  (not (member "--no-complement" (vector->list (current-command-line-arguments)))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))
(define (report-bool k pm)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (pm #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (pm #f))))
(define (report-int k pm w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([(v p) (in-pmf pm)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural v) p))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))



(define clock (start-clock))

  x5-e) (let ()

  x6-e)))

  x10-e) (let ()

  x11-e)))

  (define x16-e (if x13-e (let ()
  (define x14-e (discrete 1 (list 0.88 0.12)))

# survey.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2alea.py.
module AleaProgram
using Alea
# Julia would spend more time optimizing the long straight-line functions
# below than running them takes: they are interpreted, and Alea's own
# methods compile as usual.
Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

const EV = Ref{AnyBool}(true)
observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

function shr(x::DistUInt{W}, n::Integer) where W
    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))
end

components(x::Tuple) = reduce(vcat, map(components, x); init = Any[])
components(x) = Any[x]
width(::DistUInt{W}) where W = W

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))
    pr(a, z, y, t...; evidence = e)
    nothing
end

function dice_main()
    x1_A = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.3, 0.5, 0.2])
    x2_S = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.6, 0.4])
    x3_E = prob_equals(x1_A, DistUInt{2}(0))
    if x3_E !== false
     x4_E = prob_equals(x2_S, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x4_E !== false
      x5_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.75, 0.25])
     end
     if x4_E !== true
      x6_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.64, 0.36])
     end
     x7_E = x4_E === true ? x5_E : x4_E === false ? x6_E : ifelse(x4_E, x5_E, x6_E)
    end
    if x3_E !== true
     x8_E = prob_equals(x1_A, DistUInt{2}(1))
     if x8_E !== false
      x9_E = prob_equals(x2_S, DistUInt{1}(0))
      if x9_E !== false
       x10_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.72, 0.28])
      end
      if x9_E !== true
       x11_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.7, 0.3])
      end
      x12_E = x9_E === true ? x10_E : x9_E === false ? x11_E : ifelse(x9_E, x10_E, x11_E)
     end
     if x8_E !== true
      x13_E = prob_equals(x2_S, DistUInt{1}(0))
      if x13_E !== false
       x14_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.88, 0.12])
      end
      if x13_E !== true
       x15_E = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.9, 0.1])
      end
      x16_E = x13_E === true ? x14_E : x13_E === false ? x15_E : ifelse(x13_E, x14_E, x15_E)
     end
     x17_E = x8_E === true ? x12_E : x8_E === false ? x16_E : ifelse(x8_E, x12_E, x16_E)
    end
    x18_E = x3_E === true ? x7_E : x3_E === false ? x17_E : ifelse(x3_E, x7_E, x17_E)
    x19_R = prob_equals(x18_E, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x19_R !== false
     x20_R = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.25, 0.75])
    end
    if x19_R !== true
     x21_R = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.2, 0.8])
    end
    x22_R = x19_R === true ? x20_R : x19_R === false ? x21_R : ifelse(x19_R, x20_R, x21_R)
    x23_O = prob_equals(x18_E, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x23_O !== false
     x24_O = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.96, 0.04])
    end
    if x23_O !== true
     x25_O = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.92, 0.08])
    end
    x26_O = x23_O === true ? x24_O : x23_O === false ? x25_O : ifelse(x23_O, x24_O, x25_O)
    x27_T = prob_equals(x26_O, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x27_T !== false
     x28_T = prob_equals(x22_R, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x28_T !== false
      x29_T = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.48, 0.42, 0.1])
     end
     if x28_T !== true
      x30_T = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.58, 0.24, 0.18])
     end
     x31_T = x28_T === true ? x29_T : x28_T === false ? x30_T : ifelse(x28_T, x29_T, x30_T)
    end
    if x27_T !== true
     x32_T = prob_equals(x22_R, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x32_T !== false
      x33_T = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.56, 0.36, 0.08])
     end
     if x32_T !== true
      x34_T = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.7, 0.21, 0.09])
     end
     x35_T = x32_T === true ? x33_T : x32_T === false ? x34_T : ifelse(x32_T, x33_T, x34_T)
    end
    x36_T = x27_T === true ? x31_T : x27_T === false ? x35_T : ifelse(x27_T, x31_T, x35_T)
    return x36_T
end

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

function run_program()
    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()
task = Task(run_program, 1 << 30)
schedule(task)
wait(task)
end
